description: This file defines the DefaultReadFilter class in the PhpSpreadsheet library, implementing an interface to determine if a cell should be read during spreadsheet processing.

classes.name: DefaultReadFilter
classes.description: A filter class that implements IReadFilter, determining whether specific cells should be read.

methods.name: readCell
methods.description: Decides whether a particular cell, identified by its column, row, and optional worksheet name, should be read.
